activity.notes: Robert Menzies returned as Prime Minister of Australia on 19 December 1949 after the Liberal-Country coalition defeated Ben Chifley's government, and remained in office until his retirement on 26 January 1966. ATLAS keeps this second premiership separate from his 1939-1941 term because the office was held by other prime ministers during the intervening years.

sources.title: Robert Menzies: fast facts — National Archives of Australia
sources.citation_text: The National Archives of Australia lists Menzies' second term as Prime Minister as 19 December 1949 to 26 January 1966.

sources.title: Robert Menzies: timeline — National Archives of Australia
sources.citation_text: The National Archives timeline records Menzies becoming Prime Minister for the second time on 19 December 1949 after the federal election victory.
